basic_details.job_title: HNBGU Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated to shortlisted candidates by email only

age_limit.details: Maximum 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per ICSSR / Government of India norms.

qualification.details: Desirable skills/experience include computer skills, data analysis skills, proficiency in Unicode (Hindi), and willingness to travel.

selection_process: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated about the interview date by email only. Candidates must produce all original documents at the time of interview.
how_to_apply: Download the application form and notification PDF from the official links.
Fill out the application form with all required details and affix a recent passport-size photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates supporting your qualification, age proof, and experience.

Send the hard copies of the application along with relevant documents on or before 26.10.2026 to Dr. Amit Kumar Sharma (Project Director), Assistant Professor, Department of Hindi & MIL, H.N.B Garhwal University (A Central University), S.R.T. Campus, Tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand – 249 199.
Send soft copies of the application and documents to the Project Director's email: [email protected].
important_instructions: The post is purely temporary, tied to the project duration, and coterminous with the project. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining the post. Candidates must fulfill job requirements to complete the project in a timely manner. The association between the Project Director and the candidate can be discontinued at any time with one month’s notice in writing by either party. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview date via email only.

faq.question: Q1. What is HNBGU Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a temporary recruitment notification issued by Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University to hire 1 Research Assistant for an ICSSR Research Project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit hard copies of the application is 26.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be postgraduates in a social science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks, along with NET, M.Phil., or Ph.D.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years, with age relaxation applicable as per ICSSR or Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must send hard copies of their resume and documents to the Project Director's postal address and email soft copies to [email protected] by 26.10.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration for the Research Assistant is Rs. 37,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. Is the position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary and coterminous with the 24-month project duration.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The date and details of the interview will be intimated to shortlisted candidates by email only.
